messages:
maria.chen: Heads-up — saw a spike of 400/404 from a handful of accounts after yesterday's v2 rollout. Many of the client SDKs aren't sending the new header, so they're getting routed to the v2 endpoints and erroring. Anyone comfortable with a short-term fallback to v1 for requests that lack an explicit version header?

alec: Can you paste an example request? Is this header-based routing or path-based? :thinking:

maria.chen: Example from logs:
```http
POST /v2/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
# no X-Redwood-API-Version header present
```
Clients call /v2 path but older SDKs don't set X-Redwood-API-Version.

alec: Hm. We should avoid routing by path alone if we want safe coexistence. Proposal: routing precedence = explicit header (X-Redwood-API-Version) > token claim (client.metadata.api_version) > path fallback. If no signal, route to v1 for N days while we notify tenants.

kevin: Need to think about quota accounting and billing. If we transparently route to v1, how do we attribute tokens/usage? We can't double-bill when a middleware retries to v2 then falls back. We also need to ensure per-route quotas don't leak.

sandra: Telemetry implications: we should emit a "version_routing_decision" event with fields: client_id, chosen_version, signal_source, and probe_tag. Also sample the request body for a subset for regression checks. For fallbacks we should tag with "fallback_reason: missing_version_header".

joe: Console UX: Add a per-tenant toggle in the console -> Deployments -> Versioning: "Allow implicit v1 fallback for missing version header" with a countdown banner and link to migration guide. Default off for enterprise tenants but auto-on for free-tier? Thoughts?

alec: Defaulting behavior should be conservative. I vote default OFF for all, but enable org-level grace windows if support flips them. We can also expose a global emergency toggle for infra.

kevin: For billing, concrete plan: attribute usage to the token's tenant as usual. Add route metadata to billing rows (served_version). For retries: if a request retries within X seconds and gets served by v2 after a v1 fallback, only count the successful final response. That will require idempotency keys or request_id correlation. Is that feasible quickly?

maria.chen: We already pass x-request-id in SDKs. For flaky clients we might need to extend to all traffic. Will require a small infra change but doable.

deploy-bot: Canary toggle "implicit-v1-fallback" scheduled: stage at 10% in staging at 2025-08-18T01:00Z, canary 1: 1% prod 2025-08-18T03:00Z. Runbook: rollback on >1% error-rate increase or any spike in model regression alerts.

qa-bot: Quick note from tests: when we simulate header missing + path /v2 we saw a subset of requests where KV cache keys differ between v1 and v2 leading to cold starts. Need to document perf implications in the rollout notes.

sandra: Action items I propose:
- (alec) PR for routing precedence + config flags (short)
- (kevin) billing attribution plan and DB column for served_version
- (maria.chen) send tenant notif email + migration guide draft
- (joe) console toggle mockups + default policy options
- (sandra) telemetry event schema + sample rates
- (qa-bot) perf/regression test matrix update

alec: I'll open the routing PR this afternoon. Quick sketch for policy config (pseudo):
```json
{"routing": {"precedence": ["header","token_claim","path"], "implicit_fallback": {"enabled": false, "target_version": "v1"}}}
```

kevin: If we add served_version to billing rows, we should also export a delta metric for cost reconciliation. I'll prototype a CDC job.

maria.chen: Thanks. I'll draft the tenant email and attach console screenshots. If we keep the rollout conservative (canary + opt-ins) we should be safe.

joe: UX note: make the console toggle show expected latency delta + billing delta estimates before confirming. People want immediate numbers.

alec: Agreed. Keep the rollout gated on QA e2e and a telemetry alert that flags any config flips.

sandra: I'll post the telemetry proto in #eng-sre after lunch.

maria.chen: OK — proceeding with notifications and monitoring. Ping me if you need test tenants to validate. :thumbsup:
